description: Stock and bond trades by members of the House, read from their periodic transaction reports on the Clerk's site: owner (self, spouse, joint, child), asset and ticker, purchase or sale, trade date, date notified and the amount range, for one member, a state or district, a ticker, or the newest reports filed, with each report's link.

district.description: A state's members ("TX") or one district ("CA11").

member.description: Part of a member's name: "Pelosi", "Kevin Hern".

reports.description: How many reports to read, newest first; default 10.

ticker.description: Only trades in this ticker, among the reports read.

year.description: The year the reports were filed; default this year.

name: congress_trades

outputSchema.description: reports lists each report read with its link; transactions are their trades in the order of columns.

title: Congress trades (House transaction reports)
